_comment: Claude-style MCP example. Copy only the servers you need into the native client config: Claude .mcp.json, Gemini .gemini/settings.json, Codex .codex/config.toml, or VS Code .vscode/mcp.json (which uses the 'servers' key). Consult the client documentation for its schema. Never commit real tokens; use ${ENV_VAR} placeholders and set them locally. Spec reference: MCP 2025-11-25.

filesystem._note: Official. Args after the package are the allowed directories.

git._note: Official. Python server — use uvx (preferred) or pip install mcp-server-git.

memory._note: Official. Persistent knowledge-graph memory across sessions. Optional cross-session store that complements memory-bank/.

fetch._note: Official. Fetches a URL and converts HTML to Markdown for the model.

sequential-thinking._note: Official. Structured multi-step reasoning tool for hard problems.

github._note: Official integration. Issues, PRs, code search. Needs a PAT.

_remote_example._note: Remote (Streamable HTTP) servers replace the deprecated HTTP+SSE transport. Use a URL + type:http. The client runs the OAuth browser flow on first connect — no token needs to live in this file. Example shape only; remove the leading underscore from the key to enable.

_community_examples._note: Browser automation, search, comms, and docs servers exist as community/company packages (Playwright, Brave Search, Tavily, Slack, Notion, Perplexity, etc.) — package names and scopes vary and are NOT under @modelcontextprotocol. Verify the exact package on npm/PyPI before use. See docs/third-party-integrations.md.
